scripts.local_build: rimraf node_modules/.cache && npm run optimize-images && npm run build && (test -f public/robots.txt && mv public/robots.txt out/ || echo 'Warning: robots.txt not found') && (test -f public/sitemap.xml && mv public/sitemap.xml out/ || echo 'Warning: sitemap.xml not found') && (ls public/sitemap-*.xml 2>/dev/null | xargs -I {} mv {} out/ || true) && touch out/.nojekyll && echo 'haplivdentalclinic.com' > out/CNAME
scripts.deploy: rimraf node_modules/.cache && npm run optimize-images && npm run build && (test -f public/robots.txt && mv public/robots.txt out/ || echo 'Warning: robots.txt not found') && (test -f public/sitemap.xml && mv public/sitemap.xml out/ || echo 'Warning: sitemap.xml not found') && (ls public/sitemap-*.xml 2>/dev/null | xargs -I {} mv {} out/ || true) && touch out/.nojekyll && echo 'haplivdentalclinic.com' > out/CNAME && gh-pages -d out -t
